name: xodosign-anvil-migration
description: Migrate existing Apryse Xodo Sign (formerly eversign) e-signature integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps APIs (documents, signers, positioned fields, template merge fields, webhook events), migrates flat-PDF templates via Anvil Document AI, rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.
